speakers.name: Priya Rao
speakers.title: Chief Operating Officer, Bridge Et Al
speakers.bio: Priya Rao is a senior HR and talent strategy leader with 18+ years of experience across multinational and start-up environments. Her work spans talent acquisition, leadership and organisational development, employee engagement and HR partnering, helping organisations build leadership pipelines, high-performance cultures and flexible executive capability.

speakers.name: Virginia Cha
speakers.title: Adjunct Professor, National University of Singapore
speakers.bio: Dr. Virginia Cha is an innovation and entrepreneurship educator and practitioner with experience in technology, venture creation and business transformation. At NUS, she supports founders and senior leaders through entrepreneurship, executive education, lifelong learning and human-centred career reinvention.

speakers.name: Kanchana Gupta
speakers.title: Founder & CEO, vLookUp
speakers.bio: Kanchana Gupta is Founder and CEO of vLookUp, a technology-enabled mentoring platform connecting women professionals with mentors globally. Drawing on extensive corporate leadership experience, she advances confidence, professional growth, inclusive leadership, future-of-work readiness and access to meaningful networks.

speakers.name: Su-Yen Wong
speakers.title: Chairperson, James Cook University Singapore & Independent Director
speakers.bio: Su-Yen Wong is Chairperson of James Cook University Singapore, a global board director, leadership professor and professional speaker. With 15+ years of board experience, she has built a portfolio career spanning governance, executive advisory, academia and speaking, and founded the Remarkable Reinventors Community.

speakers.name: Maria Bianca T
speakers.title: Global CHRO, Barilla Group
speakers.bio: Maria Bianca Tulumello is Global Chief Human Resources Officer at Barilla Group, with senior HR leadership experience across Europe, the United States and Africa, including General Electric. She focuses on culture, leadership capability, organisational transformation and aligning people strategy with long-term business priorities.

speakers.name: Jacob Duer
speakers.title: President & CEO, Alliance to End Plastic Waste
speakers.bio: Jacob Duer is President and CEO of the Alliance to End Plastic Waste and a global sustainability leader. Working across industry, government and civil society, he advances plastic circularity, waste-management solutions, environmental policy and scalable multi-stakeholder partnerships.

speakers.name: Karunesh Prasad
speakers.title: Founder, Change Et Al / Board Match-Up
speakers.bio: Karunesh Prasad is an entrepreneur, board member and coach who founded Change Et Al, Bridge Et Al and Board Match-Up. Drawing on senior HR and transformation experience, he builds platforms connecting organisations with specialist, fractional, interim and advisory talent while advancing portfolio careers, board readiness and the Flex Executive Economy.

speakers.name: Achal Khanna
speakers.title: CEO, SHRM APAC & MENA
speakers.bio: Achal Khanna is a senior business and HR leader with more than 30 years of experience advancing the HR profession across India, Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Africa. She promotes inclusive workplaces, workforce capability and future-focused people practices that strengthen business resilience, transformation and sustainable performance.

speakers.name: Nancy Groesch
speakers.title: Organisational Psychologist & Executive Coach
speakers.bio: Dr. Nancy Grösch is an industrial and organisational psychologist, executive coach and transformation leader with 25+ years of international experience. She combines behavioural science with commercial insight to support complex change, culture and performance improvement, executive positioning and transitions into portfolio and flexible careers.

speakers.name: Sanjeev Jain
speakers.title: Chief Operating Officer, Wipro
speakers.bio: Sanjeev Jain is Chief Operating Officer at Wipro and a global business leader with more than 30 years of experience. He drives customer advocacy, operational excellence, organisational effectiveness and large-scale transformation, helping evolve enterprise operating models for technology disruption and the AI era.

speakers.name: Ooi Huey Tyng
speakers.title: Independent Director
speakers.bio: Ooi Huey Tyng is an independent director and former banking and payments executive with more than 30 years of experience. Her portfolio includes AIG Asia Pacific Insurance, Maxis Berhad, Raffles Institution and the Singapore Institute of Management, with responsibilities spanning risk, audit, governance, remuneration and digital transformation.

speakers.name: Philip Forrest AM
speakers.title: Business Leader & Board Advisor
speakers.bio: Philip Forrest AM is a business leader, independent director and long-standing contributor to Australia–Singapore relations. A former President of AustCham Singapore and former Singapore Institute of Directors Governing Council member, he has been recognised for his impact across governance, mentoring, community leadership and cross-border business.

speakers.name: Bassam Salem
speakers.title: Chairman, Finance & Banking Council, SwissChamHK
speakers.bio: Bassam Salem is Chairman of the Financial Services Council and a board member of SwissChamHK. A former CEO of Citi Private Bank Asia, Senior Advisor at McKinsey and founding partner of EFG Bank, he brings deep expertise in wealth management, governance, transformation, digital innovation and M&A.

speakers.name: Frank Koo
speakers.title: Speaker, Coach & Community Builder
speakers.bio: Frank Koo is Founder and CEO of Nextplay, a speaker, coach and community builder focused on career reinvention. After eight years with LinkedIn, he developed the Nextplay methodology to help executives clarify purpose, strengthen their positioning and navigate advisory, board, portfolio and entrepreneurial pathways.

speakers.name: Nitin Jaiswal
speakers.title: Founder & CEO, The 8th Continent
speakers.bio: Nitin Jaiswal is Founder of The 8th Continent and a leading voice in the longevity economy. Through AgeTech Leadership Labs, he explores how longer, healthier lives are reshaping markets, careers, financial systems, technology and purpose, positioning experience and continued contribution as valuable economic assets.

speakers.name: Probir Das
speakers.title: Group CEO, Integris Medtech
speakers.bio: Probir Das is Group CEO of Integris Medtech and a purpose-led leader with more than 30 years in medical technology, including senior Asia-Pacific leadership at Terumo. His work spans healthcare access, innovation, manufacturing, industry collaboration and public policy, combining commercial growth with clinical and social impact.

speakers.name: Brandon Lee
speakers.title: Assistant Chief Executive, Workforce Singapore
speakers.bio: Brandon Lee is Assistant Chief Executive of the Transformation Support Group at Workforce Singapore. His career spans the Singapore Armed Forces, national policy, education regulation, SkillsFuture and workforce development, with a current focus on career transformation, fractional work, portfolio careers and agile workforce ecosystems.

speakers.name: DN Prasad
speakers.title: Managing Director and Head – Work & Rewards, Singapore, WTW
speakers.bio: D N Prasad is Managing Director and Head of Work and Rewards for Singapore at WTW, with 27 years of experience in HR, organisational transformation, culture, leadership development and executive coaching. His career includes Infosys, Google and GovTech, and he founded the coaching and advisory practice Noetic Step.

speakers.name: Soorya Themudu
speakers.title: SVP Global Talent & Development, Sodexo
speakers.bio: Soorya Themudu is Senior Vice President of Global Talent and Development at Sodexo, with 25+ years of international HR leadership. She leads the Group’s global talent, culture, learning and succession agenda, having previously overseen people strategy across 11 countries and more than 90,000 employees.
